title: Quaternion-Tucker ZigZag Networks: Halving Transformer Backbone Parameters and Enabling Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.33983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Standard Transformers allocate independent dense weight matrices to every feed-forward network (FFN) layer, coupling parameters linearly with depth (O(L)) and discarding prior compute when scaling capacity. Conversely, weight-tied Looped Transformers decouple depth from parameters (O(1)) but enforce time-homogeneous updates. We formulate the L-layer FFN stack as a 3D Tensor Cuboid and introduce QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT, unifying: (1) 4D Quaternion Hamilton GEMMs in bfloat16 (4x FFN compression), (2) 64x64 Block-Diagonal Tucker SwiGLU Cores for depth-specific rotations over a shared basis, (3) Braided ZigZag Diamond Routing (L0 -> L2 -> L1 -> L3) for zero-FLOP top-down refinement, and (4) Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling in both width and depth. translated_abstract: 标准Transformer为每个前馈网络（FFN）层分配独立的稠密权重矩阵，使参数量与深度线性耦合（O(L)），并在扩展模型容量时丢弃先前的计算成果。相反，权重共享的循环Transformer（Looped Transformers）将深度与参数解耦（O(1)），但强制执行时间均匀的更新。我们将L层FFN堆栈表述为3D张量长方体，并引入QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT，统一了以下四个方面：(1) bfloat16格式下的4D四元数汉密尔顿矩阵乘法（GEMM），实现4倍FFN压缩；(2) 用于在共享基上实现深度特定旋转的64x64块对角Tucker SwiGLU核心；(3) 用于零FLOP自顶向下精炼的辫状ZigZag菱形路由（L0 -> L2 -> L1 -> L3）；(4) 宽度和深度两个维度上的精确2D零损失持续扩展。我们还引入了退火门控反弹脚手架（GatedBounce），经自蒸馏后可实现0.0%的推理开销。在算法任务上（8位奇偶校验、56个种子的路由消融实验、Mod-53 G……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT架构，通过四元数压缩、块对角Tucker分解、ZigZag菱形路由和GatedBounce自蒸馏技术，将Transformer骨干参数减半，同时实现宽度和深度两个维度上的精确零损失持续扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT, which halves Transformer backbone parameters through quaternion compression, block-diagonal Tucker decomposition, ZigZag diamond routing, and GatedBounce self-distillation, while enabling exact zero-loss continual scaling in both width and depth.
